entries.clue: Nameless being sewn from the dead in Mary Shelley's novel
Pacific island state raised from the sea floor by fire
Portrait taken at arm's length, its photographer and its subject the same
Hunched laboratory helper the movies added, absent from the novel
Warning banner that shoves itself onto a screen the second there is news
String of four or six digits that keeps a thief out of your photos
Gigabyte allowance on a tariff, always exhausted a week before payday
Frothy grey stone light enough to float, rubbed on hard heels
Cold dead body on the table, raw stuff of an unholy assembly
Walled ground of headstones that body-snatchers raided by moonlight
Cut a phone's sound to nothing so an incoming call goes unheard
Molten flood that pours down a mountainside and hardens into black rock
Long bar hauled down to throw power through the apparatus
Sicilian giant that regularly dusts Catania with grey powder
